hummingbird.title: The Hummingbird 1:4 Sugar Rule
hummingbird.popular_claim: “Always mix sugar water 1:4 (~20%) — it’s what the science says.”
hummingbird.summary: A feeder rule every site repeats, traced to papers that never prescribed it — while the ~50% sucrose study sits alone, uncited.

protein.title: The 40g Protein Ceiling
protein.popular_claim: “Your body can only absorb ~30–40g of protein per meal — more is wasted.”
protein.summary: A 20g MPS plateau in six young men became a universal digestive ceiling — a 2023 study titled ‘no upper limit’ went ignored.

dunningkruger.title: Mount Stupid
dunningkruger.popular_claim: “Incompetent people can’t know they’re incompetent — the least skilled are the most overconfident.”
dunningkruger.summary: Four small studies and an internet-fabricated curve became ‘a law of psychology’ — random numbers reproduce the curve exactly.

house.title: The $4 Billion House
house.popular_claim: “The most expensive house in the world costs $4 billion.”
house.summary: A compounded projection and a non-saleable palace became a market ‘fact’ — no $4B transaction has ever existed.

steps.title: The 10,000 Steps Commandment
steps.popular_claim: “You need 10,000 steps a day for your health.”
steps.summary: A 1965 pedometer brand’s product name became a clinical commandment — the benefit plateaus thousands of steps lower.
